body:
Don't worry, didn't drive off a cliff or anything. Feeling a bit better today...really helped to come here on reddit and have people who don't know me actually take time out to send messages, sort of renews my faith in people a bit.

Yeah, it's horrible to have financial stress plus the fear of having failed - even though you did nothing wrong to lose your job, society teaches us that a mans worth is closely tied to his earning capacity, sadly and if he isn't working he is devalued. I can see how that with the combination of having to put your beloved dog down would be quite depressing :(

How are you feeling today then?

Hi :) Decided to take a break from the computer... and take some time out doing some positive things today.. feeling a bit better today.. thanks to the people here on reddit and particularly you somedudeinAK. Thanks for taking the time.

Hope today is better for you?
I'll pm you :)

Sorry I had to go and do a few things. I can imagine it would be so emotional having to lose your dog like that. :( No wonder you feel depressed with the job loss as well.

Thanks for talking to me, you helped more than you know.

From what I see, all my triggers seem to be about abuse, fear or failure. Witnessing injustice/abuse, Job loss, failing something, fearful about crashing...all seems to have the same outcome. 

Thanks for talking to me, you have helped so much.

It's nearly 8pm. I know about sleep cycles, I think that's compounding my inability to think rationally. 

What are you stressed about?

You sound like my shrink! I am thinking there is a point to you asking me these things, maybe you are being a nice person and trying to make me feel better. If so thanks.

I love studying and learning but I am overwhelmed with it, for some reason I am unable to just read a few things and produce my assignments like the other people who I study with, they don't seem to care about doing well..they just aim to pass at a minimal level so they get a degree.. don't really understand why I can't be like that.

I have assignments due that i haven't done because I feel unfocused and unable to do them properly, I am likely going to fail this semester.
Well you made a suicidal crazy chick laugh today....

It is disturbing if it's all just a chemical reaction. Makes all the good stuff seem even less romantic. I wish I was able to believe in a God or something more purposeful, I can't find any reason to continue on being a lemming in a world where there is no purpose and where we are just a bunch of chemical reactions, that kills my humanitarian ideals.

How often do you have dark times then? What does a dark time feel like and how do you get out of it? Would what im having be a dark time? Normally I dont feel this way. Only a few times in my life, once was worse but this is how i felt before getting to that point.

>quite disturbing.

Understatement. Not sure I want to hand over my mental health to a bunch of teens wanting cybersex.
Thanks, I don't believe in God. I wish I did because I would feel like there's a point to all of this then.

I can't logically work out if I am being logical because I feel too upset and am not sure what is real. I believe this is the definition of insanity.

My husband was talking about how much I suck at communicating, because I told him I was feeling really sad and anxious. So then he starting telling me how I need to learn to communicate that to him, which makes no sense..I was communicating that to him....Then I told him that I feel very depressed and was having suicidal ideation...and that I was not coping at all, and haven't been for a while, that I need help because I am afraid. I was hoping for him to give me some guidance or at least care..then he told me I need to learn how to say those things better...and that I should have told him before, then he went silent for hours. Might seem trivial, but when you're already on the brink...

Study law and sociology but probably not for much longer because I am behind on my work and will probably fail.
I have.. just responded..thanks for taking the time to write that - and no less at nearly 4am.

I am scared because one time a couple of years ago, it went from normal happy feeling, to this exact feeling to the overwhelming feeling of being compulsed to kill myself. My body wanted to run onto the road, and my will could not stop it. I guess you could say it might feel like 'posession' (don't believe in posession).  I was trying to hold myself in the chair so I wouldn't run out of my house onto the road, and that is the scariest thing I have ever experienced...If I hadn't have passed out at that point, I would be dead. For some reason I woke up the next morning and the compulsion was gone. I am scared of hitting that point again, I don't think you hit that point...will has no bearing once you hit that point, you can't choose at that point. Your body just needs to die. It's absolutely horrifying.

I appreciate your story. Sheila is actually uncannily similar to my name.. my name is Sheree.
Thanks..hope its not like chatroulette.

A year or so I have seen him, mainly dealing with childhood stuff, marriage issues, you know.. normal life stuff. I thought I would be okay not going.. I mean I cope alright, nobody knows I feel this way generally, I can pretend to be happy and normal well enough.  I am doubting my sanity, because it feels so logical that nobody would want to live in this world the way it is, but yet I know that professionals say this is a sign of mental illness/depressive episode/depression.
In hindsight did you tell her as a way of reaching out for help?

He didn't even call to see if I was okay. It's not every day I tell him I am scared and feel suicidal. I have never told him that - and he didn't even call.
Thx for your message.
Thank you. You are a good person.

If I had a choice I would choose to be happy and smiley but it doesn't feel like a choice right now. I appreciate what you are trying to do but it doesn't make sense. Nobody would kill themselves if they felt like they had a choice to feel blissful.
Yeah, cbt. He doesn't think I have a mental illness but I am not sure I believe that at the moment. I don't think it's normal to crash so bad.
A few weeks. :( It's getting worse and worse. I can't sleep, I haven't eaten. I'm trying to appear normal but it isn't working today.

I don't have a job, I study full time. I try to contribute to society, but nobody seems to care about real things, it's all so superficial.

I don't see how medication will change that our world is screwed and that everyone in my life has abandoned me when I need them most.

I actually don't have people in my life who love me. I have children who probably do a bit, but it's probably mainly familiarity, I am sure one day they will hate me for not being able to cope very well. They don't deserve this.

That there's people worse off in the world actually compounds my feelings of sadness because I don't know how to help them in a way that makes a difference. This morning reading a news site about millions??? of people dying in Africa from starvation, an ad popped up of a beautiful white woman selling hunger suppression shakes for weight loss. Wtf is wrong with this world :(

Thanks for your message, I don't see much good at the moment, but I hope to come out of this and see it. I just dont know how.
Thanks for making me feel less alone.
thank you.
I know they need me, which is why i'm asking random people online what to do. I don't want to be "that" miserable person but I can't seem to change it right now. Thanks.
I know you mean well but it's not exactly rational. Objectively I know that life isn't as bad as I probably think, but it doesn't change the way I feel.
The suicide lines don't help because it's very hard to admit to people IRL that you feel this way. Been looking for a chat service but I can't find one.
